correctness.rationale: Using the OA scalar equation dr/dt=ar-br^3 with a=K/2-sigma and b=K/2, the orbit is monotone unless at its fixed point, with exact inverses from the reciprocal-square logistic flow. At equilibrium, renewal age has density S(t)/mu, yielding exactly p_R(r)=S(t(r))/(mu|ar-br^3|). The integrated age tail c t^(1-q)/(mu(q-1)) and the exponential versus inverse-square relaxation yield logarithmic endpoint laws off criticality and r^(2q-3) at K=2sigma; all coefficients match direct substitution. The crossover times t_±=log(1+1/z)/(2eta)+O(1) imply the stated universal locally uniform limit for fixed z>0. Reciprocal moments follow by power-law integration. The fixed-point initial state is properly excluded. Independent 24 two-sided asymptotic checks had <0.0047 relative error for eta>=1e-4 (not an asymptotic proof).
